items.q: Where does the data come from?
items.a: Official, open sources: Cadastre, ICAEN, Mapa Urbanístic de Catalunya, SNCZI and city-council open data. We don't scrape portals.

items.q: Does it replace an architect or lawyer?
items.a: No. It's an orientation tool; it doesn't replace a technical survey, legal review or valuation. Every report says so.
